# DocuPotion

DocuPotion generates PDF and PNG documents from reusable templates and structured data.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docupotion/.

## Actions

- **Create Document**: Generate one PDF or PNG from a DocuPotion template and dynamic data.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Return the connected DocuPotion account identity and current document usage against its plan limit.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Return all DocuPotion templates available to the connected account, including each template ID required to create a document.
